explainedBy: She is rebutted: the host says the savior reading is wrong and the real wound lies elsewhere.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Keeps the stage; only the callout changes to name the outlier.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the picture repeats the previous beat; the new words are carried by the label.

storyboard.addedInformation: The letter in hand is the instrument of the building.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; her face turns from neutral to anxious as the narration says "desperately".
storyboard.addedInformation: The anxious grip shows the need behind the correspondence.

storyboard.onScreenText: She never had that family tree.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The thing she builds is drawn: a tree beside the letter-writer.
storyboard.addedInformation: The tree names what the letters add up to; it reads literally as a family tree.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: The ocean is drawn: distance as a safe space.
storyboard.addedInformation: Water stands for the ocean the narration names.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Face moves from neutral to a warm one: the chosen role.
storyboard.addedInformation: The smile shows the generous role she picks.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; her face changes as the news lands.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; the face moves from shock to hurt.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the secret itself (who knew, for how long) is only in the label.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: The letter is lowered; the body bows under the truth.
storyboard.addedInformation: Posture shows the weight, the label states the idea.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; only the label changes.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the letter's beauty is only in the label.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the letter to the house it remembers.
storyboard.addedInformation: The house icon and kitchen make the remembered home literal.

storyboard.concreteVisual: Same kitchen, Sybil holding the letter, tender and sad.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; the private code word lands.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the code word is only in the label.

storyboard.concreteVisual: Same desk, Sybil holding the unsent note.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The same unsent note, now judged.
storyboard.addedInformation: The unsent note stays on screen.

storyboard.concreteVisual: Sybil alone, bowed, silent.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Widens from Dan to the whole family's habit.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the habit is only in the label.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; the host adds the reason.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the reason is only in the label.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: The host turns to the other view.
storyboard.addedInformation: The icon reads as the writing in question.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the question: permanence.
storyboard.addedInformation: The letter held after death shows permanence.

storyboard.claim: She can hold his love and forgiveness in her hands and reread it when she doubts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sybil holding the letter with a heart icon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; the letter is given what it holds.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same stage; the icon names the delay.
